scope: Tracked paragraph-property revisions (w:pPrChange): accept, reject, model sync and UI

implementation.parse: listRevisions already enumerates w:pPrChange/w:rPrChange as format revisions; text now shows the affected paragraph/run text instead of a technical node name
implementation.reject: restoreFormat replaces current pPr children with the historical w:pPr inside pPrChange, then syncParagraphModel re-reads style/heading/align/indent/lineSpacing/shading/borders/list state into the WordParagraph model so the UI updates without reload
implementation.accept: pPrChange is removed, current properties stay, model is re-synced
implementation.markup: paragraphHasRevision now detects pPrChange/rPrChange, so format-only revisions show the change bar; markup 'all' paragraph block also renders text-align/shading like the normal block

checks: pPrChange parsed as format revision {align:'left', revision text 'Định dạng đoạn'}
pPrChange reject restores paragraph format {align:'center', indent:720}

runtimeQA.sample: pPrChange-sample.docx (current left, pPrChange stores old center + indent 720)
runtimeQA.revisionText: Đoạn có thay đổi định dạng

remaining: Spellcheck/grammar is a local rule set, not Microsoft Editor parity
Ink is rendered as an SVG overlay, not native ink
Real-document page count varies 145-147 between loads because heights are measured asynchronously
VBA macros cannot run in the browser (same as Word for the web)
